docs.title: Model names
docs.attribution: © Ollama contributors — MIT License, via docs-mesh
docs.snippet: Model names follow a model:tag format, where model can have an optional namespace such as example/model. Some examples are orca-mini:3b-q8_0 and llama3:70b. The tag is optional and, if not provided, will default to latest. The tag is used to identify a specific version.
